cs.NE.authors: Byungwoo Kang, Maceo Richards, Bernardo Sabatini

cs.NE.title: gPC-based robustness analysis of neural systems through probabilistic recurrence metrics
cs.NE.authors: Uros Sutulovic, Daniele Proverbio, Rami Katz, et al.

cs.NE.title: How much neuroscience does a neuroscientist need to know?

cs.NE.title: A neural network for modeling human concept formation, understanding and communication
cs.NE.authors: Liangxuan Guo, Haoyang Chen, Yang Chen, et al.

cs.NE.authors: Ryutaro Uchiyama

cs.NE.title: Unveiling the Heart-Brain Connection: An Analysis of ECG in Cognitive Performance
cs.NE.authors: Akshay Sasi, Malavika Pradeep, Nusaibah Farrukh, et al.
cs.NE.summary: Understanding the interaction of neural and cardiac systems during cognitive activity is critical to advancing physiological computing. cs.NE.authors: Mohadeseh Shafiei Kafraj, Dmitry Krotov, Peter E. Latham

cs.NE.title: Rogue Variable Theory: A Quantum-Compatible Cognition Framework with a Rosetta Stone Alignment Algorithm
cs.NE.authors: Jacek Małecki, Alexander Mathiesen-Ohman
cs.NE.summary: Many of the most consequential dynamics in human cognition occur \emph{before} events become explicit: before decisions are finalized, emotions are labeled, or meanings stabilize into narrative form. cs.NE.authors: Barna Zajzon, Younes Bouhadjar, Maxime Fabre, et al.
cs.NE.summary: Sequential structure is a key feature of multiple domains of natural cognition and behavior, such as language, movement and decision-making. cs.NE.authors: Colin Scheibner, Lindsay M. Smith, William Bialek

cs.NE.title: Muscle Synergy Patterns During Running: Coordinative Mechanisms From a Neuromechanical Perspective
cs.NE.authors: Ye Ma, Shixin Lin, Shengxing Fu, et al.
cs.NE.summary: Running is a fundamental form of human locomotion and a key task for evaluating neuromuscular control and lower-limb coordination. cs.NE.authors: Nimrod Sherf, Si Tang, Dylan Hafner, et al.

cs.NE.title: Non-stationary dynamics of interspike intervals in neuronal populations
cs.NE.authors: Luca Falorsi, Gianni V. Vinci, Maurizio Mattia
cs.NE.summary: We study the joint dynamics of membrane potential and time since the last spike in a population of integrate-and-fire neurons using a population density framework. cs.NE.title: Dynamical incompatibilities in paced finger tapping experiments
cs.NE.authors: Ariel D. Silva, Claudia R. González, Rodrigo Laje

cs.NE.authors: Wendyam Eric Lionel Ilboudo, Saori C Tanaka
